snippet.title: Apni Mang Suhagan Ho - | Amitabh, Shah Rukh, Kajol, Kareena, Hrithik | Karwa Chauth Special
snippet.description:
Celebrate the beautiful spirit of Karwa Chauth with Apni Mang Suhagan Ho from Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham in this special Lyrical Video.

Featuring the unforgettable voices of Amit Kumar, Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan & Kavita Krishnamurthy, with music by Jatin-Lalit and lyrics by Sameer Anjaan, this timeless melody beautifully captures the love, devotion and togetherness of Karwa Chauth.

Relive the iconic moments of Shah Rukh Khan and Kajol and let this evergreen Bollywood melody make your Karwa Chauth celebrations even more special. ✨🎶

#apnimangsuhaganho #karwachauth #karwachauthspecial #karwachauthsongs #kabhikhushikabhiegham #shahrukhkhan #kajol #jatinlalit #sameeranjaan #amitkumar #sonunigam #alkayagnik #uditnarayan #kavitakrishnamurthy #lyricalvideo #bollywoodsongs #hindisongs #romanticsongs #karwachauthspecialsongs

Credits:
Song Name: Apni Mang Suhagan Ho
Movie: Kabhi Khushi Kabhie Gham
Singers: Amit Kumar, Sonu Nigam, Alka Yagnik, Udit Narayan, Kavita Krishnamurthy
Composer: Jatin-Lalit
Lyricist: Sameer Anjaan

Lyrics:
Apni maang suhaagan ho
Sang hamesha sajan ho
Aake meri duniya mein
Vapas na jaana
Sehra baand ke mahi
Tu mere ghar aana
Oye soni kithi soni aaj tu lagdi ve
Bas mera saath yeh jodi teri sajdi ve
Roop aaisa suhana tera
Chaand bhi hai deewana tera
Ja re ja oh joothe
Teri galla hum na maane
Kyun taareefein karta hai tu
Hum toh sab kuch jaane
Ho o o o … meri dil ki dua yeh kahe
Teri jodi salamat rahe
Oh sajan ji
Haan sajan ji
Yunhi beete saara jeevan saath mein
Bole chudiyan
Bole kangana
Haai main ho gaya tera saajna
Tere bin jiyo naiyyo lagda
Main te margaiyan
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Dil lehja lehja … ho ho o
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Dil lehja lehja … ho ho o
Aaja Heeriye … o ja ja Ranjhana
O aaja Heeriye … ja ja Ranjhana
Lehja lehja … dil lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … dil lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … dil lehja lehja
Lehja lehja … soniye lehja lehja
Aa aa … kabhi khushi kabhie gham
Na judaa honge hum

snippet.title: Dune: Part Three | Final Trailer
snippet.description:
Do not fear the end. Dune: Part Three only in theaters and IMAX December 18. Tickets on sale now around the world. http://fandan.co/DunePartThree #DuneMovie #FilmedForIMAX 

From Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures comes Dune: Part Three, bringing Academy Award-nominated filmmaker Denis Villeneuve’s epic trilogy to a breathtaking conclusion.

Dune: Part Three is set nearly two decades after Paul Atreides seized control of the Imperium. Now a ruthless Emperor, Paul must face the consequences of his reign as old allies return, terrifying new threats emerge, and betrayal lurks in every shadow. Haunted by visions of Imperial collapse and the reappearance of his long-lost love, Paul is drawn into a sweeping conspiracy, with Chani at the heart of its unfolding mystery. As rebellion brews and enemies close in, Paul must confront the true cost of power and the fate of those he loves the most.

The film stars Oscar nominee Timothée Chalamet, Zendaya, Jason Momoa, Oscar nominee Florence Pugh, Rebecca Ferguson, Isaach de Bankolé, with Oscar nominee Charlotte Rampling, with Anya Taylor-Joy, and Robert Pattinson, and Oscar winner Javier Bardem.

Villeneuve directs from a screenplay by Villeneuve and Brian K. Vaughan, based on the novels written by Frank Herbert. The film is produced by Oscar nominees Mary Parent, Cale Boyter, Villeneuve and Tanya Lapointe, and Joe Caracciolo, and executive produced by Joshua Grode, Thomas Tull, Herbert W. Gains, Brian Herbert, Byron Merritt, Kim Herbert, Kevin J. Anderson, Richard P. Rubinstein, John Harrison and Jessica Derhammer.

Joining Villeneuve behind the camera are Oscar-winning director of photography Linus Sandgren, Oscar-winning production designer Patrice Vermette, Oscar-winning editor Joe Walker, Oscar nominated costume designer Jacqueline West, Oscar-nominated casting director Francine Maisler, and Oscar-winning composer Hans Zimmer.

Warner Bros. Pictures and Legendary Pictures Present A Legendary Pictures Production, A Film By Denis Villeneuve, Dune: Part Three, only in theaters and IMAX® across North America on December 18, 2026 and internationally beginning 16 December 2026. The film will be distributed worldwide by Warner Bros. Pictures and in China by Legendary East.

snippet.title: EETHA Trailer | Shraddha Kapoor | Randeep Hooda | Laxman Utekar | Ajay-Atul | Maddock Films | Dec 4
snippet.description:
Experience the extraordinary life, grit, and passion of Maharashtra’s legendary folk artist Vithabai Narayangaonkar in EETHA! 🎭✨

Starring Shraddha Kapoor in an iconic avatar alongside Randeep Hooda and Mohammed Zeeshan Ayyub, EETHA is directed by Laxman Utekar (Chhaava, Mimi, Luka Chuppi) and produced by Dinesh Vijan’s Maddock Films.

Set against the rich, vibrant backdrop of Lavani and Tamasha, EETHA tells the awe-inspiring true story of a fearless woman who dedicated her life to the stage and became a timeless cultural icon. Music composed by the legendary duo Ajay–Atul.

In Cinemas Worldwide on 4th December 2026.

--------------------------------------------------

snippet.title: Karwa Chauth Ki Aarti | Karwa Chauth Song | Karwa Chauth Aarti | Om Jai Karwa Maiya | Karwa Chauth
snippet.description:
Welcome sacred marital bliss, long life, and eternal harmony into your family with the divine recitation of "Karwa Chauth Ki Aarti" (ॐ जय करवा मैया - Karwa Mata Ki Aarti). Dedicated to Karwa Mata, Goddess Parvati, and Lord Shiva, this auspicious devotional Aarti cleanses your home of negative energies, removes domestic misunderstandings, and fills your surroundings with pure positive vibrations, love, and divine grace.

Performing and listening to Om Jai Karwa Maiya on the auspicious occasion of Karwa Chauth and evening puja rituals brings the protective shelter of Mother Divine directly into your married life. As the supreme symbol of devotion, sacrifice, and marital fidelity (Pativrata Dharma), Karwa Mata dissolves hardships, blesses spouses with longevity, good health, and mutual respect, and surrounds the household with lasting peace and prosperity.

Spiritual Significance & Meaning:
This sacred Aarti offers humble devotion to Karwa Mata, seeking Her maternal benevolence to safeguard one's husband's life and ensure continuous happiness in marriage. By lighting a sacred deepam, listening to the Karwa Chauth Vrat Katha, and singing this Aarti after sighting the moon and offering Arghya, devotees express total faith and receive divine protection against all adversities.

Key Benefits of Chanting & Listening:
• Bestows long life, vibrant health, and safety for one's husband (Akhand Saubhagya).
• Cultivates deep mutual love, understanding, and lifelong marital harmony.
• Clears away domestic stress, anxiety, and negative household vibrations.
• Brings the benevolent grace and blessings of Karwa Mata and Goddess Gauri.
• Essential devotional Aarti for Karwa Chauth Vrat, evening puja, and Moon Arghya rituals.

Best Time to Listen:
• During Karwa Chauth evening Vrat Puja while narrating the Karwa Chauth Katha.
• At night during the sighting of the moon (Chandra Darshan) and Arghya rituals.
• Every morning and evening during Navratri and dedicated Gauri/Parvati puja days.

snippet.title: Aaj Se Teri - 8K Video | Arijit Singh | Akshay Kumar, Radhika | Padman | Karwa Chauth Special
snippet.description:
Celebrate the beautiful promise of togetherness with “Aaj Se Teri” in stunning 8K, featuring Akshay Kumar and Radhika Apte, sung by Arijit Singh and composed by Amit Trivedi. ❤️🎶

Song: Aaj Se Teri
Singer: Arijit Singh
Music: Amit Trivedi
Lyricist: Kausar Munir

Crew Names:-
Produced & Arranged by - Amit Trivedi
Recording Engineers A T Studios  Mumbai  - Abhishek Sortey & Urmila Sutar 
Assisted by  Firoz Shaikh
Mixed by - Shadab Rayeen,  A T Studios & New Edge - Mumbai Assisted by : Abhishek Sortey & Dhananjay Khapekar
Mastered by - Donal Whelan, Masteringworld - U.K.
Executive Producer A T Studios - Krutee Trivedi
Head Of Production A T Studios - Aashish Narula

Musician Names:-
Programmed by Amit Trivedi, Gourab Dutta & Raja Rasaily
Dholak & Percussions - Sanket Naik  
Mandolin, Saz & Bouzouki - Tapas Roy  
Shehnai - Omkar Dhumal

Cast - Akshay Kumar, Radhika Apte & Sonam Kapoor
Production House - Hope Production Pvt Ltd
Producer - Twinkle Khanna, SPE Films India, KriArj Entertainment, Cape Of Good Films & Hope Productions
Director - R Balki

Lyrics:
Mukhda -
Aaj Se Teri Saari Galiyaan Meri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Mera Ghar Tera Ho Gaya…

Aaj Se Teri Saari Galiyaan Meri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Mera Ghar Tera Ho Gaya…
Aaj Se Meri Saari Khushiyaan Teri Ho Gayi,
Aaj Se Tera Gum Mera Ho Gaya. 

Ho Tere Kandhe Ka Jo Til Hai, 
Ho Tera Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai, 
Ho Teri Bijli Ka Jo Bill Hai-
Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Ho Mere Khwabon Ka Ambar,
Ho Meri Khushiyon Ka Samandar,
Ho Mere Pin Code Ka Number-
Aaj Se Tera Ho Gaya. 

Antara 1- 
Tere Maathe Aaaaa….Tere Maathe Ke Kumkum Ko
Main Tilak Lagaa Ke Ghoomoonga, 
Teri Baali Ki Chhunchhun Ko
Main Dil Se Lagaa Ke Jhoomoonga…

Meri Chhoti Si Bhoolon, 
Ko Tu Nadiya Mein Baha Dena.
Tere Jude Ke Phoolon Ko, 
Main Apne Shirt Mein Pehnoonga.

Bas Mere Liye Tu Maalpue Kabhi Kabhi Bana Dena…

Aaj Se Meri Saari Ratiyaan Teri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Tera Din Mera Ho Gaya. 

Ho Tere Kandhe Ka Jo Til Hai, 
Ho Tera Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai, 
Ho Teri Bijli Ka Jo Bill Hai-
Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Ho Mere Khwabon Ka Ambar,
Ho Meri Khushiyon Ka Samandar,
Ho Mere Pin Code Ka Number-
Aaj Se Tera Ho Gaya. 

Antara 2-
Tu Maange Sardi Mein Amiya, 
Jo Maange Garmi Mein Mungphaliyaan, 
Tu Baarish Mein Agar Keh De,
Ja Mere Liye Tu Dhoop Khila.

Toh Main Sooraj……. Toh Main Sooraj Ko Jhatak Doonga, 
Toh Main Saawan Ko Gatak Loonga,
Toh Saare Taaron Sang Chanda
Main Teri Goad Mein Rakh Doonga-

Bas Mere Liye Tu Khil Ke Kabhi Muskuraa Dena…

Aaj Se Meri Saari Sadiyaan Teri Ho Gayi, 
Aaj Se Tera Pal Mera Ho Gaya. 

Ho Tere Kandhe Ka Jo Til Hai, 
Ho Tere Seene Mein Jo Dil Hai, 
Ho Teri Bijli Ka Jo Bill Hai-
Aaj Se Mera Ho Gaya…

Ho Mere Khwaabon Ka Ambar,
Ho Meri Khushiyon Ka Samandar,
Ho Mere Pin Code Ka Number-
Aaj Se ……Tera Ho Gaya.

bn.description:
Kick-এ লাইভ স্ট্রিম - https://kick.com/mrspikeyt

📷 ইন্সটাগ্রাম - https://www.instagram.com/mrspike10/

📧mrspikeinquiry@gmail.com

➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖

✅কপিরাইট আইন ১৯৭৬-এর ১০৭ ধারা অনুযায়ী কপিরাইট দাবিত্যাগ, সমালোচনা, মন্তব্য, সংবাদ প্রতিবেদন, শিক্ষাদান, বৃত্তি এবং গবেষণার মতো উদ্দেশ্যে "ন্যায্য ব্যবহারের" অনুমতি দেওয়া হয়েছে। ন্যায্য ব্যবহার হলো কপিরাইট আইন দ্বারা অনুমোদিত এমন একটি ব্যবহার, যা অন্যথায় লঙ্ঘনমূলক হতে পারে। অলাভজনক, শিক্ষামূলক বা ব্যক্তিগত ব্যবহার ন্যায্য ব্যবহারের পক্ষে ভারসাম্যকে ঝুঁকে দেয়।

✅ভিডিও গেম ডিসক্লেইমার: এই ভিডিওর বিষয়বস্তু শুধুমাত্র শিক্ষামূলক ব্যবহারের জন্য। গেমপ্লেটি হলো Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) নামক একটি ভিডিও গেম এবং এটি একটি কাল্পনিক সৃষ্টি।

➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖
✅যারা আমার ভিডিও দেখেন, লাইক, শেয়ার এবং কমেন্ট করেন, তাদের সবাইকে অসংখ্য ধন্যবাদ। আপনাদের কাছে এটি হয়তো একটি ছোট বিষয় মনে হতে পারে, কিন্তু আমি আপনাদের প্রত্যেককে আন্তরিকভাবে ধন্যবাদ জানাই। আপনাদের দেওয়া সমস্ত মতামত এবং মন্তব্যই আমাদের চ্যানেলকে আজকের এই পর্যায়ে নিয়ে আসতে সাহায্য করেছে।
তাই আবারও, আপনাদের সবাইকে অসংখ্য ধন্যবাদ!!! 😍

➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖➖

snippet.description:
Cyclone Arnab Alert LIVE: चक्रवात 'अर्नब' से मचाई तबाही, UP में अलर्ट | Cyclone Arnab |Forecast

उत्तर प्रदेश में चक्रवात ‘अर्णब’ के संभावित प्रभाव को लेकर मौसम विभाग और प्रशासन की तैयारियों पर नजर है। अगले तीन दिनों तक मौसम में बदलाव की आशंका के बीच मुख्यमंत्री योगी आदित्यनाथ ने अधिकारियों को सतर्क रहने और फील्ड में सक्रिय रहने के निर्देश दिए हैं।

खराब मौसम के दौरान लोगों की सुरक्षा सुनिश्चित करने और जरूरत पड़ने पर उन्हें सुरक्षित स्थानों पर पहुंचाने को कहा गया है। तेज हवाओं, वज्रपात और बेमौसम बारिश की आशंका से किसानों की चिंता भी बढ़ सकती है।

snippet.title: Karwa Chauth Hindi Song 2026 | Sangini Music #karwachauthsong
snippet.description:
#karwachauth #karwachauthsong #karvachauth #sanginimusic
“Jug Jug Jiyo Re Piya” (जुग-जुग जियो रे पिया) is a romantic Karwa Chauth song blending Hindi lyrics, a Bihari/Bhojpuri folk touch and two contrasting female voices. Celebrate Karwa Chauth 2026 with a wife’s heartfelt blessing for her beloved.

Celebrate the sacred bond of Karwa Chauth with this soulful Karwa Chauth song, perfect for your festive family gatherings.

This video captures the essence of the occasion, showcasing traditional customs and the spirit of togetherness that defines this special day. Whether you are preparing for the evening ceremonies or gathering with loved ones, this track provides the perfect musical backdrop to honor your customs and observe your Karwa Chauth rituals.

Our new festive Hindi song features authentic melodies and heartfelt lyrics that reflect the joy and devotion shared during this occasion. It is designed to accompany your celebrations, bringing a sense of peace and cultural connection as families come together to observe age-old traditions through traditional Indian music. This performance highlights the beauty of an Indian festival celebration, capturing the serene and devotional atmosphere of the night.

🌙 KARWA CHAUTH: HISTORY, TRADITIONS & SIGNIFICANCE

Karwa Chauth, also written Karva Chauth and known as Karaka Chaturthi, is a long-standing Hindu observance associated especially with North India. It falls on Kartik Krishna Chaturthi in the North Indian calendar. “Karwa” refers to a small earthen pitcher, and “Chauth” to the fourth lunar day. Its heritage is preserved in regional customs and devotional legends, including the story of Veeravati, shared through Karwa Chauth vrat katha.

Traditionally, married women fast from sunrise until moonrise, often without food or water, and pray for their husbands’ well-being. Customs include the pre-dawn sargi meal in some communities, mehendi, bridal adornment, Maa Gauri or Parvati puja, and gatherings for the vrat katha. At moonrise, many offer water to the moon, view it and their husband through a sieve, and break the fast with their husband’s help.

Celebrated particularly in Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, Uttar Pradesh, Himachal Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh and Delhi, the festival brings together prayers for marital well-being, family bonds and enduring love. Customs vary across families and regions.

🎶 THE MUSIC

An earthy Bihari/Bhojpuri-style female folk voice answers a soft Hindi female lead through repeated blessings, call-and-response and a shared refrain. Dholak, tabla and manjira bring an eight-beat keherwa groove, with harmonium, bansuri and shehnai colours, acoustic guitar, warm bass and atmospheric synth textures. Indian folk warmth meets contemporary fusion in this festive love song.

❤️ LINES FROM THE SONG

जुग-जुग जियो रे पिया,
जनम-जनम के मीत हो पिया,
तोहसे लागे प्रीत हो पिया।

मैया गौरी से माँगा है मैंने,
लंबी उमर का वरदान मिले।
सदा सुहागन रहूँ हमेशा
खुशियों से परिवार खिले।

सात जनम भी कम पड़ जाएँ,
हर जनम लिख दूँ तेरे नाम।

🎧 Listen with headphones or a good music system to enjoy the contrasting voices, layered harmonies and folk instruments.

यह करवा चौथ गीत हर उस प्रेम और प्रार्थना को समर्पित है, जिसमें अपने जीवनसाथी की खुशियाँ ही सबसे अनमोल उपहार होती हैं।

Dedicate this song to your life partner and tell us your favourite line in the comments. If it touches your heart, like, share and subscribe for more music.
